name: The Source of the Corruption
summary: Felwood’s waters carry corruption down from Mount Hyjal, sickening its plants. You are sent to find the hermit Ketharas, who may know what has happened on the mountain.

sections.title: Waters from Hyjal
sections.body: Felwood’s plants are diseased, and its waters bring fel taint down from Mount Hyjal. The druid who sends you believes the land cannot heal until the trouble on the mountain is resolved. Ketharas, a hermit with deep knowledge of Hyjal, may know what has happened there. Find him on the mountain.

faq.answer: Waters running down from Mount Hyjal carry fel taint into Felwood, where it soaks into the ground and diseases plants.
Ketharas is a druid hermit who lived in the wild and knows Mount Hyjal well.
You are sent to find Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.

faq.q: Why am I looking for Ketharas?
faq.answer: Ketharas knows Mount Hyjal well and may know what has happened there.
The druid who sends you believes Felwood cannot heal until the problem on Mount Hyjal is resolved.

angles.text: As a druid, you are sent to seek Ketharas, a hermit druid whose knowledge of Mount Hyjal may explain the corruption reaching Felwood.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Source of the Corruption
